inventoryClusters.title: Inventory Types
inventoryClusters.description: Choose which inventory types to include per channel. Transit covers inventory on moving objects only — screens and wraps on buses, taxis, trains, trams and ferries while they move. Fixed inventory at bus stations, rail platforms or airports is not transit; target those environments via Venue Types below.

programmaticBuying.description: Programmatic inventories are digital screens bought automatically through connected exchanges (DSPs), with real-time delivery and reporting.
programmaticBuying.toggleDescription: When on, the plan prefers programmatic-capable inventories first. If your budget cannot be fully consumed by programmatic inventory, the unspent portion is automatically shifted to the other inventory types you keep selected below.
programmaticBuying.lockedNote: Programmatic targeting is on because a DSP is selected in Step 1. Set the DSP back to None to turn it off.
programmaticBuying.noDigitalChannelNote: Programmatic-only targeting isn't available because this plan doesn't include the Digital OOH channel. Non-digital inventory such as Classic OOH (printed billboards, wraps, posters) can't be bought programmatically — add the Digital OOH channel in Step 1 to enable this option.

why_plan.note: Milestones split the flight into Ramp, Mid-flight and Closeout thirds; achievement % follows an S-curve pacing of the plan's forecast against the goal target. Reasons are derived from geography, plan economics and targeting.

inventory.impressions: The total number of times the ad is displayed on this screen over the plan period
inventory.reach: The number of unique individuals estimated to see the ad at least once
inventory.frequency: The average number of times each unique person sees the ad (Impressions ÷ Reach)
inventory.cpmRate: Cost per 1,000 impressions — rate charged for every 1,000 views
inventory.cpsRate: Flat cost charged per individual ad play on this screen
inventory.estimatedCost: Projected total spend for this inventory based on plan dates and rate card
inventory.adPlays: Total number of times the ad will play on this screen during the plan
inventory.screens: Number of physical screens or displays at this inventory location
inventory.poi: Nearby points of interest — locations like malls, offices, and transit hubs surrounding this inventory
inventory.owner: The media owner or operator responsible for managing this inventory

schedule.days: Days of the week this inventory is scheduled to display your ad
schedule.hours: Operating hours during which your ad will be displayed on this screen
schedule.slotDuration: Duration of each individual ad slot in seconds
schedule.expectedImpressions: Projected number of times your ad will be seen based on this schedule
schedule.adPlays: Total number of times your ad will play on this screen during the plan
schedule.sov: Share of Voice — percentage of available ad slots on this screen occupied by your plan
schedule.trafficLevel: Each time block is tiered by its share of the day's activity: Low (under 25%), Medium (25–49%), High (50% and above).

performance.totalImpressions: The total number of people expected to be exposed to your ad. For each ad play, the number of devices (people) detected in the vicinity of the inventory is counted. Impressions = Ad Plays × Avg Audience per Play.
performance.estimatedReach: The number of unique individuals estimated to pass by the inventory at least once during the plan period. Derived from device detection data, deduplicated so each person is counted only once regardless of how many ad plays they were present for.
performance.frequency: The average number of times each unique individual is estimated to be present near the inventory during an ad play. Calculated as Total Impressions ÷ Estimated Reach. A frequency of 2.3 means each person is exposed on average 2–3 times across the plan.
performance.plannedAdPlays: The total number of times your creative is scheduled to play across all inventory slots for the plan duration. Each ad play is a single broadcast of your creative on one screen.
performance.avgCpmCost: The average cost per 1,000 impressions across all inventory in this plan. Calculated as (Total Media Cost ÷ Total Impressions) × 1,000. Useful for comparing cost efficiency between plans.
performance.eCpm: The effective cost per 1,000 impressions based on the actual plan rate agreed upon, inclusive of all fees and discounts. Reflects the true cost of reaching 1,000 viewers under the negotiated terms.
performance.sov: Percentage of total ad plays your plan gets compared to all possible ad slots on the selected inventory during the plan period.
performance.sot: Total hours your ads will be displayed compared to the total operational hours of the inventory. Shows time-based exposure rather than play count.

planSummary.inventories: Number of inventory panels currently in the plan.
planSummary.impressions: Total expected ad exposures. Ad Plays × Avg Audience per Play, summed across all selected inventory.
planSummary.reach: Unique individuals expected to pass by selected inventory at least once during the plan, deduplicated.
planSummary.frequency: Average times each unique person is exposed. Impressions ÷ Reach.
planSummary.adPlays: Total scheduled creative broadcasts across all inventory slots for the plan duration.
planSummary.co2PerPlay: Estimated CO₂e per ad play, based on screen energy consumption.
planSummary.co2PerPlayNoData: No carbon data available for the current selection.
planSummary.avgCpm: Average cost per 1,000 impressions across selected inventory. (Total Media Cost ÷ Impressions) × 1,000.
planSummary.eCpm: Effective CPM at the agreed plan rate, inclusive of fees and discounts.
planSummary.sov: Share of Voice — your planned ad plays vs total available ad slots on the selected inventory.
planSummary.sot: Share of Time — total airtime your creative will be on screen across the plan, computed as Ad Plays × 15s spot length. Currently {percent}% of the inventory's operating time.
planSummary.cost: Planned media cost across selected inventory.
planSummary.remaining: Budget left after the current plan. Negative values mean the plan is over budget.
